observations: Photo 0: Black PlayStation console with a gold PlayStation logo on top, placed on a white surface with blue lighting. Two controllers are visible: one clear/transparent, one red and black camouflage. A hand is partially visible on the left. A black cable is connected to the console.

Photo 1: Same console from a slightly different angle, showing the top and front edge. The console appears dusty or smudged. A hand holds the left side. The same two controllers are in the background.

Photo 2: Similar view to photo 1, with the console centered. The top surface shows visible smudges and dust. The PlayStation logo is faintly visible. The same two controllers are present. A hand is on the left side of the console.
All photos show the same console and controllers from slightly different angles. No disc, power supply, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in any photo.
The console is slim in form factor, consistent with PS4 Slim model.

claims.claim: Clean ps4 slim 1TB used like brand new
claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 show visible smudges, dust, and fingerprints on the top surface of the console, contradicting 'clean' and 'like brand new'.
Two controllers (pads) are visible in all photos. No disc is visible in any photo. The disc may be present but not shown.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Storage capacity may not be 1TB (could be 500GB or 250GB model)
risks.proof: Photo of the console's label or system settings screen showing the storage capacity.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have battery issues
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
risks.if_unproven: priced as one controller may be faulty

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out together.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's label or system settings screen showing the storage capacity (to verify 1TB).
Photo showing the included disc (if any).
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The console's condition contradicts the 'clean' and 'like brand new' claim due to visible smudges and dust. The 1TB capacity and disc inclusion are unverified. Functionality and completeness of accessories are unknown. Proof is needed to determine the true value.
